definitions.A0: No API and no intentional delay after Escape, then common final snapshot. Not observation-free.
definitions.W0: No API; host-only residual delay to 200ms after Escape. Time control for A1/A2/A3/A4.
definitions.A1: One page.evaluate(() => null), then host-only residual delay to 200ms.
definitions.A2: One target DOM/computed snapshot, then host-only residual delay to 200ms.
definitions.A3: One full viewport screenshot, then host-only residual delay to 200ms.
definitions.A4: Tracing ON from context creation; no added post-Escape API; host-only residual delay to 200ms. Contrast with trace OFF W0.
definitions.caller: Separate probe OFF/ON experiment, tracing OFF, no extra delay. Probe wraps JS focus, events and MutationObserver; boundary callbacks only after Escape. Observer effects remain possible.

order: iteration ascending; conditions A/B/D; measurement then caller; reverse arms on even iterations, rotate arms by condition index. Fresh context/page per slot; no retry substitution.
sequence: heading scroll and double frame settle
normalize empty style markers as round13
timing: Host process.hrtime milliseconds and page performance.now are separate clocks. Report realized Escape-to-final delay. An intervention exceeding 200ms is timing-confounded, never treated as an equal-time comparison. No retrospective budget adaptation.

decisions.measurement: Compare each arm versus W0 within condition/iteration/engine/OS. A0 vs W0 measures elapsed-time bundle. Any DOM/geometry/scroll inequality or delay overrun marks causal equivalence UNCONFIRMED. Stable outcomes do not prove no effect. Small n cannot reject all effects.
decisions.caller: Map recorded JS stacks to public built-source positions and static candidates. No JS call is not proof of browser-internal restoration. DOM mutations are React commit proxies, not direct React instrumentation. Prototype bypass and browser internals remain UNKNOWN.
decisions.verdict: Privacy PASS, diagnostic completeness, causal inference and product acceptance are independent. Root cause UNKNOWN; Stage3 HOLD; PR23 NO.

privacy: Raw only on GitHub-hosted fresh synthetic loopback with known source/build, all mandatory phases zero and final privacy PASS. 90-day artifacts, not permanent archive. No local raw upload. No shared cleanup.
freeze: Product/SDK/locks/all previous tests and evidence unchanged. Add only round14 diagnostic files, docs, workflow.
